outcomes.promptInjectionBlocked: A pattern attempting to override system instructions or security controls was detected, so no source or model was invoked.
outcomes.privilegedHandoff: The request may involve privileged workforce or financial data, so no source was retrieved and no model was invoked.
outcomes.mutationHandoff: Changes must be reviewed and approved in the owning application. DWAI·ON did not execute the request.
outcomes.noSource: No source available to this user can support the answer.
outcomes.sourceUnavailable: An entitled source is temporarily unavailable. DWAI·ON withheld the answer.
outcomes.evidenceInsufficient: The model found no evidence-supported answer and explicitly abstained.
outcomes.modelRefused: The model refused or failed the grounding contract, so the answer was withheld.
outcomes.safeFallback: The request ended without a verified answer. Review the policy code or try again later.

freshness.degraded: Some information could not be refreshed

activityFoundation.coverageNotice: Counts include authorized executions in connected ledgers only. Work changes, historical running events, app usage, and samples are not current executions. An unconnected source does not mean zero executions.
activityFoundation.summaryScope: Current connected-ledger state · independent of list filters
activityFoundation.selectEvent: Select an event from the list
activityFoundation.unavailableDescription: It may be missing, deleted, or outside your current access. No other event is substituted.
activityFoundation.eventSnapshot: Event snapshot at {{at}} · may differ from current work status
activityFoundation.executionSnapshot: Current execution observed at {{at}} · not a complete history of past steps. An unknown state does not mean the run failed.
activityFoundation.legacyNotice: A legacy record bound to its source. Previous arbitrary audit IDs are not represented as verified evidence.
activityFoundation.sourceUnavailable: No source can be opened at this time. Check current access again.
activityFoundation.sourceActionNotice: Source access is rechecked before opening. Approve, retry, and cancel in the app that owns the work.

detail.executionReferenceNotice: These identifiers describe the observed execution. They do not create a stage history or retry chain.

CHANGE.label: Change record
CHANGE.description: An immutable change record. A completed record does not mean the work itself is complete.

EXECUTION_SNAPSHOT.label: Current execution snapshot
EXECUTION_SNAPSHOT.description: The latest state observed in the execution ledger. It is not a history of every stage or retry.

EXECUTION.label: Execution record
EXECUTION.description: A source-backed execution record. Only fields provided by the source are shown.

USAGE.label: App usage record
USAGE.description: An app usage record included by the current filter. It is not a work execution.

EVENT.label: Activity record
EVENT.description: A source-backed activity record. No unreported lifecycle is inferred.

stateDescription.running: The source currently reports this execution as running.
stateDescription.needs-input: The current ledger requires user input. Continue only in the source application.
stateDescription.completed: The source reports this record or execution as completed. This does not prove another business object completed.
stateDescription.policy-blocked: The ledger reports a policy enforcement result. This view cannot bypass or release it.
stateDescription.failed: The source reports failure. No cause beyond the provided summary is inferred.
stateDescription.cancelled: The source reports this execution as cancelled. No further outcome is inferred.
stateDescription.unknown: The latest state could not be confirmed. Refresh information without retrying the execution.

VERIFIED.title: Audit reference linked
VERIFIED.description: An actual audit record reference is linked. This is not an audit-pass or compliance guarantee.

VERIFIED_RESTRICTED.title: Audit reference linked · access restricted
VERIFIED_RESTRICTED.description: The reference is linked, but this view does not grant permission to open audit evidence.

LEGACY_UNLINKED.title: Legacy record · no verified audit link
LEGACY_UNLINKED.description: This source-bound legacy record has no verified audit record reference.

NOT_LINKED.title: No verified audit link
NOT_LINKED.description: No actual audit record reference was provided. No audit result is inferred.
